_description: Evaluate the initial seed priority function and every cycle's best_prio.py on heldout data using the same calibration-first flow as PostProcesingData.evaluate_priofunction, while optionally restricting only the heldout scoring rows to one ancestry.

documentation.run_dir: Required. FunSearch run directory that already contains cycle_XXXX/best_prio.py files and the copied run config.used.json with experiment.seed_priority_path.
documentation.training_pickle_path: Required. Training pickle path or JSON array of training pickle paths. These rows are the reference set used for calibration-feature construction.
documentation.calibrating_pickle_path: Required. Calibration pickle path or JSON array of calibration pickle paths. These rows are used in full to fit the calibration model for every priority function.
documentation.heldout_pickle_path: Required. Heldout pickle path or JSON array of heldout pickle paths. These are the rows scored after calibration. When heldout_target_ancestry_group is set, only the matching heldout rows are evaluated, but training + calibration still stay as the heldout reference set.
documentation.output_row_tracking_path: Required. Tracking DataFrame pickle used to map heldout rows back to source shard ancestry labels.
documentation.supported_ancestry_groups: Required. Allowed ancestry labels as they appear in output_row_tracking.pkl source shard names.
documentation.heldout_target_ancestry_group: Optional. Set to one supported ancestry label to evaluate only that ancestry within heldout. Use null or omit the field to evaluate all heldout rows and still report per-ancestry columns.
documentation.function_name: Optional. Name of the priority function defined in the seed and best_prio.py files. Defaults to 'priority'.
documentation.calibration_penalties: Optional. Non-empty JSON array of ridge penalties tried during calibration model fitting.
documentation.calibration_partitions: Optional. Integer worker count or 'auto' for the calibration oracle-feature build, matching PostProcesingData.evaluate_priofunction behavior.
documentation.scoring_partitions: Optional. Integer worker count or 'auto' for the heldout oracle-feature build, matching PostProcesingData.evaluate_priofunction behavior.
documentation.distance_cache_enabled: Optional. When true, reuse or create ancestry-distance caches exactly as the main evaluator does.
documentation.distance_cache_dir: Optional. Existing or new cache directory. Point this at a compatible distance_cache_dir from a previous single-priority PostProcesingData.evaluate_priofunction run to reduce recomputation.
documentation.output_root_dir: Optional. Parent directory where the troubleshooting tool creates one timestamped output subdirectory per run. Defaults to TroubleShooting/DynamicsOfHeldOut/OutputDir.
documentation.output_dir_tag: Optional. Short label appended to the timestamped output directory name to make runs easier to recognize.
documentation.seed_prio_function_path: Optional. Explicit path to the initial seed priority function. If omitted, the tool reads run_dir/config.used.json and uses experiment.seed_priority_path.
